title: subagent: Test network access via subagent

content: Test whether you have any working network access. Try: websearch with query "Wikipedia Dragon", webfetch of "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dragon", and bash command "curl -sI https://example.com". Report exactly which tool calls succeeded or failed, and if any succeeded, paste the returned content. Do not do anything else.
